li.p: After injecting the sealant, immediately drive the vehicle at speeds above approximately 20 km/h (12 mph) for about 10 minutes to ensure even distribution of the sealant.
Do not leave your vehicle running in a poorly ventilated area for extended periods of time. Carbon monoxide poisoning and suffocation can occur.
If the tire pressure is below 200 kPa (29 psi), do not drive the vehicle. The tire may cause accident.
If the sealant injection hose is not fully connected to the tire valve, the sealant may flow back and block the valve.

For your safety, do not exceed a driving speed of approximately 80 km/h (50 mph). If abnormal vibrations or noise occur during driving, reduce speed, park in a safe location. Have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

When you use the Tire Mobility Kit, the wheel may be stained by sealant. Therefore, remove the wheel stained by sealant and have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
